fields.description: Date the error was raised in the browser.
fields.label: Posting Date

fields.description: Time of day the error was raised, in the site's timezone.
fields.label: Posting Time

fields.description: Triage state. Everything lands as Open.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Error stops the user; Warning is recoverable; Info is a note.
fields.label: Severity

fields.description: The exception class or failure kind — TypeError, ReferenceError, HTTP 500, ValidationError.
fields.label: Error Type

fields.description: The message as the browser reported it.
fields.label: Error

fields.description: Full JavaScript stack, or the server traceback for a failed API call.
fields.label: Stack Trace

fields.description: The record type being worked on when it broke, when the page knows one.
fields.label: Doctype

fields.description: The specific record, when there is one.
fields.label: Reference Name

fields.description: Portal page path, without the query string — this is what groups errors by screen.
fields.label: Page Route

fields.description: Full URL including the query string, so a filtered view can be reproduced exactly.
fields.label: Page URL

fields.description: The whitelisted method that failed, for an API error.
fields.label: API Method

fields.description: HTTP status returned by that call (0 = the request never completed).
fields.label: HTTP Status

fields.description: Script the error was thrown from.
fields.label: Source File

fields.description: The logged-in user who hit it.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Browser viewport in CSS pixels — tells a layout bug from a logic bug.
fields.label: Viewport

fields.description: Device platform as the browser reports it (Android, iPhone, Win32, Linux).
fields.label: Platform

fields.description: How many times this same error has been reported. Repeats increment this row instead of filing a new one.
fields.label: Occurrences

fields.description: Hash of type + message + route + source line. Identical errors share it, which is what lets repeats collapse.
fields.label: Fingerprint

fields.description: What was done about it.
fields.label: Resolution Notes
